remediation_history: An initial run found `phase0-fixture`'s releaseRuntimeClasspath resolving Kotlin coroutines 1.10.2 absent from its gradle.lockfile, and several android/* modules (tracebox-api, tracebox-core, tracebox-directboot, tracebox-export, tracebox-export-ui, tracebox-storage) and tooling/tracebox-gradle-plugin had never had a gradle.lockfile committed at all. Both gaps were pre-existing drift accumulated across Phases 1-4, not something this phase's own commits introduced (verified: this phase's own commits touching Rust/Kotlin were dependency-neutral). Regenerated locks for every module via `gradlew <module>:dependencies --write-locks --no-daemon --offline` across all 11 subprojects in one pass, then re-ran this script end-to-end and confirmed exit code 0.
certification_status: Not certified; the device/OEM/physical matrix required for FOUNDATION_CERTIFIED remains unavailable in this environment (consistent with Phase 0's ADR-0008 record). All currently-available host-level automated evidence across Phases 1-5 passes in one consolidated run.
